pullRequests.title: feat(tools): make the tools safe for the refactor
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase0-tools
pullRequests.body:
Adds move_src.py, check_all.sh and nested source folders.
A trial move of 989snd.c and pause.c kept all code and data bytes and all report numbers.

pullRequests.title: docs(repo): add style guide and split docs into reference and agents
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase1-docs
pullRequests.body:
Adds STYLE, REVIEWING, BUILD and a docs index, and moves long docs to docs/reference and docs/agents.
Only comments changed in src: loaded bytes are the same as main and report numbers did not change.

pullRequests.title: ci(repo): add syntax, lint, tests, ratchet and Doxygen jobs
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase2-ci
pullRequests.body:
CI now parses all C with clang, runs tool tests and lint, and fails if a refactor count goes up.
It needs no disc and no toolchain, so the match is still checked locally with check_all.sh.

pullRequests.title: style(repo): format all C with clang-format
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase3-format
pullRequests.body:
Formats src and include with a pinned clang-format, and CI now checks it. Wrapped prototypes get extern so line-based tools still read them.
Loaded bytes and all report numbers are unchanged; the extern and alias counts rose once for those prototypes.

pullRequests.title: ci(repo): drop Doxygen and PR comment jobs
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/ci-trim
pullRequests.body:
CI keeps four jobs: C parses, tool tests, lint and the existing progress report.
There is nothing to deploy, so the Doxygen site and its config are gone.

pullRequests.title: refactor(repo): remove 8730 unused extern declarations
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase4-game-headers
pullRequests.body:
Adds tools/tidy/prune_externs.py and removes file-scope externs nothing uses, keeping any a version fragment, header macro or asm string needs.
Each folder passed check_all with the same loaded bytes and report numbers.

pullRequests.title: refactor(repo): move 372 shared prototypes into per-file headers
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase4-protos
pullRequests.body:
Replaces 2032 local declarations with 104 headers, one per defining source file, for plain functions every file declares the same way.
check_all passes with the same loaded bytes and report numbers; declarations with addressing qualifiers stay in their files.

pullRequests.title: refactor(repo): remove dead local types and share hero views
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase4-structs
pullRequests.body:
Removes 143 unused local types and replaces 131 per-level hero view copies with seven named types in include/structs/hero_views.h.
check_all passes with the same loaded bytes and report numbers.

pullRequests.title: refactor(overlays): convert 53 private hero views to struct Hero
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase4-hero-views
pullRequests.body:
Replaces offset views of g_hero such as G_8 and P231ae0 with named struct Hero fields, using tools/tidy/conv.py.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports; five views that change bytes or fail to convert stay private and are listed in conventions.md.

pullRequests.title: refactor(repo): convert 10 private pad and camera views to shared structs
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase4-views
pullRequests.body:
Replaces views of the pad state and main camera with PadState and CameraSystem fields, using tools/tidy/conv.py.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports; views that changed bytes stay private and are listed in conventions.md.

pullRequests.title: refactor(repo): share DiscTable and convert 11 private disc_table views
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase4-disc-table
pullRequests.body:
Moves DiscTable to include/structs/disc.h and replaces views like ((LevelLoad *)&x)[i].b with named fields such as x[i].sector.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports; two views that index from a base pointer stay private.

pullRequests.title: refactor(repo): convert private moby views in 14 files to struct Moby
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase4-moby
pullRequests.body:
Converts views that map cleanly to struct Moby fields; views with more casts than fields stay private and are listed in conventions.md.
All reports and 5116/5116 functions are unchanged; oclass_literals rose by 3 because hidden class comparisons now use the real field.

pullRequests.title: refactor(include): sort headers into enums, structs and pvars folders
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase4-layout
pullRequests.body:
Moves headers into include/enums, include/structs and include/pvars, and splits types.h and macros.h out of common.h. Adds ARRAY_COUNT and STRUCT_OFFSET.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports.

pullRequests.title: fix(repo): declare functions before first use and split multi-line asm strings
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase4-syntax
pullRequests.body:
Takes clang syntax errors from 50 to 28 with same-bytes fixes: unprototyped declarations before first use, and adjacent asm strings.
check_all passes with the same reports; the 28 left are block-scope redeclarations that can steer addressing, so they move to the Phase 7 fakematch list.

pullRequests.title: refactor(include): split names.h into one generated part per level
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase4-names
pullRequests.body:
names.py now writes include/names/ with one part per level plus executable and shared_levels. Tools read the table through tools/names_header.py.
The table has the same 12526 names, and check_all passes with the same reports.

pullRequests.title: refactor(repo): move 236 more shared declarations into headers
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase4-data-externs
pullRequests.body:
Replaces 1388 local declarations using headers for functions and plain data. Spelling no longer blocks a move: s32 and int are the same type, and parameter names are ignored.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports.

pullRequests.title: refactor(repo): share usage_stats and convert 30 private views
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase4-usage-stats
pullRequests.body:
Adds include/structs/usage_stats.h, so S141948.fF8 becomes usage_stats.e[31].count. Also removes the last local scalar typedefs.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports.

pullRequests.title: refactor(repo): share CollisionHit across 14 files
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase4-collision
pullRequests.body:
Adds include/structs/collision.h and replaces local copies and views of coll_hit_result with it, so normal_x becomes normal.f[0].
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports.

pullRequests.title: refactor(repo): share well-named local types in topic headers
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase4-struct-sweep
pullRequests.body:
Moves newlib, GS, swarm and animation types into topic headers, and gives Pair, UV_2bb0b0, Quad4 and V6 real names in small_records.h.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports.

pullRequests.title: refactor(pause): convert the last private menu_system views
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase4-menu
pullRequests.body:
Replaces the four remaining private views of menu_system in pause.c with MenuSystem fields.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports.

pullRequests.title: refactor(repo): use moby class names in comparisons and comments
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase5-moby-class
pullRequests.body:
Generates include/enums/moby_class.h with 576 names, replaces 429 class number comparisons and rewrites 201 comments, so class 0x3EF becomes the class name.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports; numbers with no known name stay.

pullRequests.title: refactor(repo): name 64 functions and 8 types after their moby class
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase5-type-names
pullRequests.body:
Moby1034Update becomes rocket_1034_update and spawn_class_32_moby becomes spawn_rocket_50_moby, through config/names_local.tsv. A class number only maps when one reading of it is in the table.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports.

pullRequests.title: refactor(repo): use button names for 967 pad masks
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase5-pad
pullRequests.body:
g_controller_state.pressed & 0x40 becomes & PAD_CROSS. Only expressions that are certainly the pad change; a local named held stays.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports.

pullRequests.title: refactor(repo): use level names for 474 level numbers
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase5-level
pullRequests.body:
Adds include/enums/level.h, so g_current_level_index == 5 becomes == LEVEL_RILGAR. Only the level index globals change, not locals named level.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports.

pullRequests.title: refactor(repo): use hero state names for 7249 state numbers
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase5-hero-state
pullRequests.body:
g_hero.state.current == 7 becomes == HERO_STATE_JUMP, and Hero_SetMoveState(7, 1) takes the name too. Numbers with no name, and control_mode, stay.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports.

pullRequests.title: refactor(core): name the hex-named core files and sort them by library
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase6-core-names
pullRequests.body:
src/core/00116FA0.c becomes src/core/libc/vfprintf.c, and so on for all 53 files, in libc, kernel, sif, gs, cdvd, mc, mpeg, vu0, input, sound, storage and startup.
Object edges and link order stay. check_all passes, function statuses are unchanged in every version, and report units keep their old names.

pullRequests.title: refactor(game): sort src/game into folders by system
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase6-game-folders
pullRequests.body:
Moves src/game into system, gameplay, render, moby, ui, audio and math, and keeps the movie folder. File names stay: they are the original source names.
check_all passes, function statuses are unchanged in every version, and report units keep their old names.

pullRequests.title: docs(credits): remove a community credit entry
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: chore/remove-community-credit
pullRequests.body:
Removes a community credit entry from the credits. Documentation only; no code or build changes.
🤖 Generated with Claude Code

pullRequests.title: feat(tools): add fakematch_scan and tag 118 suspect sites
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase7-scan
pullRequests.body:
Tags volatile, register, if (0) and block-scope redeclarations with FAKEMATCH comments, lists them in config/fakematch.tsv, and CI keeps the two in step. A ratchet stops the count growing.
Comments only: check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports.

pullRequests.title: fix(repo): remove 48 volatile and register hacks the match never needed
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase7-remove
pullRequests.body:
Each tagged volatile and register was removed one at a time and kept out only if its file still matched. Inline asm is no longer tagged, because it stays as written.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports; 25 volatile sites and 3 if (0) blocks were needed and stay tagged.

pullRequests.title: feat(data): move 158 data blocks into C with values generated locally
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase8-data
pullRequests.body:
Adds tools/data_in_c.py and src/data/: each file gives a block its name and owner, and the values are generated from your own baserom, so no retail bytes are committed. Code keeps its externs, so its compile does not change.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports; compiled data goes from 0.57% to 24.17%.

pullRequests.title: feat(data): move 345 more data blocks into C, including core_data
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase8-data2
pullRequests.body:
Adds shorts, bytes, strings, float bits and the core_data blob. Blocks with several users or none go in src/data/shared/, because a block's position does not show its owner. No values are committed.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports; compiled data goes from 24% to 69%.

pullRequests.title: feat(data): move 375 pointer blocks into C with generated references
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase8-pointers
pullRequests.body:
Blocks that point at functions and data now build from C. Each reference gets a generated declaration aliased to its symbol, so committed C has no values and no new aliases.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports; compiled data goes from 69% to 74%.

pullRequests.title: refactor(repo): convert 67 raw moby offsets to fields
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase5-offsets
pullRequests.body:
*(unsigned char *)(moby + 0x20) becomes ((Moby *)moby)->state. Also fixes a rawhero.py crash; its output read worse than the original, so it was not applied.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports.

pullRequests.title: fix(repo): resolve 6 block-scope redeclarations reasoned safe
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase7-hand
pullRequests.body:
Merges identical types (UPath, E04), drops pointer-only prototype differences, and moves two declarations to file scope. None of these can steer addressing.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports; clang errors go from 28 to 22.

pullRequests.title: fix(repo): move volatile onto fields and settle 6 sites with KEPT reasons
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase7-volatile
pullRequests.body:
SlidePairVars already had two volatile fields, so its other two casts become fields. Six sites get a KEPT comment: the store stays out of the delay slot, or the short $gp declaration needs the cast.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports; volatile tags go from 25 to 15.

pullRequests.title: fix(repo): settle 16 redeclarations with fixes and KEPT reasons
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase7-redecl
pullRequests.body:
Five conflicts become one view: disc_table, lvl_resource_buffers, item_price_table, rope_particles and the lightning points. Ten more stay with a KEPT reason, such as lh against lhu or $gp addressing.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports; clang errors go from 22 to 16.

pullRequests.title: docs(repo): record what two fakematch sites do, from compiler output
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/phase7-sample
pullRequests.body:
Without its cast, select_moby_context differs by one store's place, so it stays tagged with that reason. The local holding 0xFF in update_moby_offset_motion is ordinary C, so it becomes KEPT.
Comments only: check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports.

pullRequests.title: feat(tools): add gate_loop, land_pr and check_regressions
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/stage1-tooling
pullRequests.body:
gate_loop reverts files that break a match and exits non-zero on anything else. land_pr merges only on the newest commit's checks. check_regressions compares statuses and ignores paths.
The syntax baseline now names each error, so fixing one cannot hide a new one. A deliberate break in plasmabot.c was found and reverted by the loop.

pullRequests.title: style(repo): use readable names in comments and wrap long ones
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/stage2-comments
pullRequests.body:
Comments now use readable names where one exists, status tags go, and comment-only lines over 120 characters wrap. Provenance text is unchanged and was compared.
Comments only: check_all passes with the same reports.

pullRequests.title: refactor(repo): drop address suffixes from 760 local type names
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/stage2-types
pullRequests.body:
Vars_A7078 becomes Vars where the short name is free in that file, its version fragments, every header and the name table. Comments follow; provenance text does not change.
check_all passes with the same reports.

pullRequests.title: docs(kb): restore type names a script wrongly shortened
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/stage2-doc-fix
pullRequests.body:
The doc edit in #206 turned names that no longer exist into Moby, Pad and D. This restores them.
Docs only.

pullRequests.title: refactor(repo): remove local aliases that named the only view of a symbol
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/stage2-aliases
pullRequests.body:
extern s32 level_r[] asm(...) becomes a plain declaration, and the code says level. Aliases stay when the file has two views, a header or version fragment needs them, the symbol has no readable name, or in src/core.
check_all passes with 5116/5116 functions and the same reports; one file was reverted by the gate because its alias changes the code.

pullRequests.title: docs(src): remove stale near-miss notes from comments
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/stage2-notes-docs
pullRequests.body:
Notes that called a function a near-miss are gone or reworded, since all 5116 now match. Provenance text is unchanged, and close_dtoa.c's comment tabs are now spaces.
check_all passes with the same reports.

pullRequests.title: docs(repo): add where things are, checks and what is left
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/stage2-docs
pullRequests.body:
docs/README.md now says where things are, which checks to run and what is left. CONTRIBUTING and WORKFLOW say all functions match, and a stale header path in INCLUDES is fixed.
Docs only: check_all passes.
